requests.name: m_nail_tip_scratch_skin
requests.why: 육아_36 도입부 통념 반박 뒤쪽(7.56~14.32초 '영국 국민보건서비스도 손톱이 길게 태어나는 아기가 있으니, 긁지 않게 잘라 주라고 해요', 전체 화면 — '손이 아니라 손톱' X 다음). 길고 얇은 손톱 끝이 피부 단면 겉을 쓸고 지나가며 겉층이 가늘게 갈라진 호박색 줄이 남는다 — 상처를 내는 건 손가락 살이 아니라 손톱 끝. ⚠️ 근거(NHS 'in case they scratch themselves')만큼 — 피·깊은 상처는 그리지 않는다. 색인 전수 확인(긁기·할퀴기·손톱·상처·긁힘) — act_scratch_shin(어른이 자기 정강이를 긁음, 전신 다리)·m_tissue_tear(세포층이 V자로 찢어짐, 손톱 없음)·part_nail(손톱 점등만)뿐, 손톱 끝이 피부를 긁는 단면 0건. 아기 단어·몸 없이 손가락 끝과 피부 블록만. 범용 — 아기 얼굴 긁힘·손톱 관리·아토피 긁기·태열 편에 쓴다.

requests.flow: One continuous shot in a single unbroken scene with no scene cuts. 0-2s: from the very first frame the fingertip sweeps quickly across the skin surface and the long thin nail edge drags along it, the camera tracking fast beside the nail. 2-4s: behind the nail a fine thin line opens in the top layer of the skin and glows soft warm amber along its length, the soft pad of the fingertip itself leaving no mark where it touches. 4-6s: the fingertip lifts away out of frame, and the camera dives low over the surface to show the thin amber scratch line through the top layer only, holding until the very last frame. No blood and no deep cut at any moment. Style lock: every structure stays rendered as the same translucent pale cyan glass with softly glowing edges in the dark slate blue-grey void from the first frame to the very last; the scene never turns opaque, matte, mint green, beige, illustrated or photorealistic. No face, no whole hand, no person anywhere in the frame; only the single fingertip and nail. No text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no arrows anywhere in the frame. Low ambient synth hum with one faint soft scratch sound, no music, no dialogue.
